keys.name: INGEST_SECRET
keys.hint: Shared secret the ingest box presents to post packets and pull outbound work

keys.name: OPERATOR_SECRET
keys.hint: Operator's machine credential for admin scripts; unset closes those paths

keys.name: SESSION_SECRET
keys.hint: Key that signs sign-in sessions; must differ from the ingest and operator secrets

keys.name: SESSION_TTL_DAYS
keys.hint: Days a sign-in session lasts

keys.name: SESSION_EPOCH
keys.hint: Unix seconds: sessions minted before this time are refused

keys.name: TRUST_PROXY
keys.hint: 1 when a reverse proxy fronts the instance, so x-forwarded-for is trusted

keys.name: TRUST_CF
keys.hint: 1 when the origin is reachable only through Cloudflare, so cf-connecting-ip is kept

keys.name: ADMIN_CALLSIGNS
keys.hint: Comma-separated licensed calls that may administer this instance

keys.name: INSTANCE
keys.hint: Federation instance id (domain); defaults to the host of APP_URL

keys.name: FED_PRIVATE_KEY
keys.hint: Ed25519 federation signing key (base64 JSON); set, feeds are signed

keys.name: FED_KEY_HISTORY
keys.hint: JSON array of previous and revoked federation public keys

keys.name: FED_ROTATIONS
keys.hint: JSON array of signed key-rotation records, each new key vouched by the old

keys.name: FED_ROTATION_GRACE_DAYS
keys.hint: Days a rotated-away key keeps verifying when its history names no end

keys.name: FED_REGISTRY
keys.hint: Signed federation registry document (JSON), verified under FED_REGISTRY_KEY

keys.name: FED_REGISTRY_KEY
keys.hint: Pinned public key (base64url) of the registry authority

keys.name: FED_REGISTRY_DNS
keys.hint: DNS TXT record name whose url= locates the signed registry

keys.name: FED_OPERATOR
keys.hint: Operator label this instance publishes in /.well-known

keys.name: FIRST_PARTY_SITES
keys.hint: Receiving-site calls preset as trusted for Tier A (Instance admin adds more)

keys.name: MIN_TRUST
keys.hint: Lowest tier a find needs to count as verified: B (Location-verified) or A (Radio-verified)

keys.name: FED_PEERS
keys.hint: Comma-separated base URLs of federation peers to sync from

keys.name: FED_DISCOVER
keys.hint: 1 learns the peers that trusted peers advertise

keys.name: FED_CORROBORATION_QUORUM
keys.hint: Distinct corroborating identities required to promote a find to Tier A

keys.name: FED_AUTO_PROMOTE
keys.hint: Confirmed corroborations that promote an unvetted peer to trusted (0 = off)

keys.name: FED_CORROBORATION_SECRET
keys.hint: Shared secret corroboration questions must carry (x-fed-secret)

keys.name: FED_CORROBORATION_REQUIRE_KNOWN
keys.hint: 1 answers corroboration questions only from known, non-blocked peers

keys.name: FED_SPOKE_STALE_HOURS
keys.hint: On a hub, hours without a submission before a spoke shows as stale

keys.name: FED_REVEAL_IGATE
keys.hint: 1 includes the exact IGate in corroboration answers

keys.name: FED_SYNC_REGION
keys.hint: S,W,N,E box in decimal degrees: pull only the caches inside it from peers

keys.name: FED_ENDPOINTS
keys.hint: JSON array of this instance's transport endpoints {transport,address,priority}

keys.name: FED_ALLOW_PRIVATE
keys.hint: 1 lets federation fetch private and loopback addresses (an all-LAN network)

keys.name: FED_SUBMIT_SECRET
keys.hint: Hub: enables record submission; spoke: the secret it pushes with

keys.name: FED_SUBMIT_INSTANCES
keys.hint: Hub: comma-separated instance ids allowed to submit (else any but self)

keys.name: FED_HUB_URL
keys.hint: Spoke: URL of the hub this instance pushes its signed records to

keys.name: FED_RELAY_SECRET
keys.hint: Shared secret that enables the rendezvous relay between hub and spokes

keys.name: RETENTION
keys.hint: JSON of retention overrides for diagnostic tables, e.g. {"packetsHours":6}

keys.name: MESHCOM_META_MIN_S
keys.hint: Seconds between rewrites of an unchanged MeshCom node or link row

keys.name: MESHCOM_NODE_TTL_DAYS
keys.hint: Days without a hearing before a MeshCom node is pruned

keys.name: MESHCOM_LINK_TTL_HOURS
keys.hint: Hours without a sighting before a MeshCom link is pruned

keys.name: POS_MIN_MOVE_M
keys.hint: Metres a station must move before its next fix is stored (0 stores every fix)

keys.name: POS_MIN_INTERVAL_S
keys.hint: Seconds after which a fix is stored even without movement (0 stores every fix)

keys.name: DOH_URL
keys.hint: Validating DNS-over-HTTPS resolver; it must return the DNSSEC AD flag

keys.name: AMPR_DNS_RESOLVERS
keys.hint: Comma-separated DoH resolvers that must agree on an unsigned ampr.org answer

keys.name: AMPR_REQUIRE_DNSSEC
keys.hint: 1 accepts ampr.org callsign verification only with a DNSSEC-validated answer

keys.name: LOTW_CA_PEM
keys.hint: PEM certificates of the ARRL LoTW CAs trusted for callsign verification

keys.name: OKAPI_BASE
keys.hint: OpenCaching node to import caches from, e.g. https://www.opencaching.de

keys.name: OKAPI_KEY
keys.hint: OpenCaching OKAPI consumer key for that node

keys.name: IMPORT_ALLOW
keys.hint: Comma-separated import sources whose permission the operator holds (wwff, iota, gcau)

keys.name: SERVICE_CALL
keys.hint: The instance's on-air call for radio commands and mail; default the sysop's call -15

keys.name: RADIO_REPLIES
keys.hint: 1 sends a text reply to each FOUND, DNF and NOTE radio command

keys.name: API_RATE_WINDOW_SEC
keys.hint: Length of the public read-API rate-limit window, in seconds

keys.name: API_RATE_ANON
keys.hint: Read-API requests per window without a key

keys.name: API_RATE_KEYED
keys.hint: Read-API requests per window with a free key

keys.name: SPOTS_ENABLED
keys.hint: 1 enables outbound activity-spot polling

keys.name: SPOTS_SOURCES
keys.hint: Comma-separated spot sources to poll (else every built-in source)

keys.name: SPOTS_TTL_SEC
keys.hint: Seconds between upstream spot polls; never below a source's own floor

keys.name: SPOTS_USER_AGENT
keys.hint: User-Agent sent to spot upstreams

keys.name: SPOTS_RECEPTION_URLS
keys.hint: JSON endpoints of the reception networks {pskreporter,dxcluster,rbn}

keys.name: GMA_API_KEY
keys.hint: API key from GMA (gma.rocks); GMA spots are polled only with one

keys.name: BASEMAP_STYLE
keys.hint: Map widget basemap: a MapLibre style URL, or offline for the built-in grid

keys.name: BASEMAP_HOSTS
keys.hint: Extra comma-separated origins the basemap style loads tiles or fonts from

keys.name: APP_URL
keys.hint: Public origin people open, e.g. https://aprs.example.net

keys.name: CORS_ORIGINS
keys.hint: Extra comma-separated origins allowed credentialed CORS

keys.name: RP_ID
keys.hint: Passkey (WebAuthn) domain; defaults to the host of APP_URL

keys.name: EMAIL_FROM
keys.hint: Sender address for sign-in links and digest mail

keys.name: EMAIL_API_KEY
keys.hint: API key of the Resend-compatible email provider

keys.name: ALLOW_DEV_TOKENS
keys.hint: 1 returns sign-in tokens in-band when email is unset (dev and CI only)

keys.name: OPERATOR_LINKS_FOR_ANY_CALL
keys.hint: 1 lets the operator's sign-in link serve every call, not only admin calls

keys.name: VAPID_PUBLIC
keys.hint: Web-push VAPID public key (base64url)

keys.name: VAPID_PRIVATE
keys.hint: Web-push VAPID private key (base64url)

keys.name: VAPID_SUBJECT
keys.hint: Contact the push service sees; default mailto:OPERATOR_EMAIL, else https://<instance host>

keys.name: SUPPORT_LINKS
keys.hint: JSON array of donation links [{label,url}] shown on /support

keys.name: SOURCE_REPO
keys.hint: Published source URL (AGPL §13); a modified fork must set its own

keys.name: OPERATOR_NAME
keys.hint: Person or entity operating this instance, shown on /imprint and /privacy

keys.name: OPERATOR_ADDRESS
keys.hint: Operator's postal address; commas separate the lines

keys.name: OPERATOR_EMAIL
keys.hint: Operator's contact address, also the privacy contact

keys.name: SECURITY_CONTACT
keys.hint: Contact URIs in /.well-known/security.txt; default mailto:OPERATOR_EMAIL

keys.name: SOURCE_COMMIT
keys.hint: Commit or tag the instance runs; resolved at build or start when unset

keys.name: SOURCE_TAG
keys.hint: Release tag the instance runs

keys.name: SOURCE_BUILT_AT
keys.hint: Build time in unix seconds

keys.name: INGEST_URL
keys.hint: Gateway ingest endpoint the box posts packet batches to

keys.name: BATCH_MS
keys.hint: Interval in milliseconds between batch flushes to the gateway

keys.name: INGEST_SPOOL_MAX
keys.hint: Most undelivered packets kept while the gateway is unreachable (oldest dropped)

keys.name: APRSIS_HOST
keys.hint: APRS-IS server to read the feed from

keys.name: APRSIS_PORT
keys.hint: APRS-IS server port

keys.name: APRSIS_CALLSIGN
keys.hint: Callsign the box logs in to APRS-IS with

keys.name: APRSIS_PASSCODE
keys.hint: APRS-IS passcode for that callsign; -1 logs in receive-only

keys.name: APRSIS_FILTER
keys.hint: APRS-IS server-side filter (e.g. r/lat/lon/km) limiting the feed

keys.name: KISS_TNC_HOST
keys.hint: Host of the KISS TNC over TCP; set it to enable the TNC

keys.name: KISS_TNC_PORT
keys.hint: TCP port of the KISS TNC

keys.name: AGWPE_HOST
keys.hint: Host of the AGWPE server; set it to enable AGWPE

keys.name: AGWPE_PORT
keys.hint: TCP port of the AGWPE server

keys.name: AGWPE_RADIO_PORT
keys.hint: AGWPE radio port to use (0 is the first)

keys.name: HOSTMODE_HOST
keys.hint: Host of the WA8DED host-mode TNC; set it to enable host mode

keys.name: HOSTMODE_PORT
keys.hint: TCP port of the WA8DED host-mode TNC

keys.name: HOSTMODE_MYCALL
keys.hint: Callsign the host-mode TNC is set to

keys.name: HOSTMODE_RADIO_PORT
keys.hint: Host-mode radio channel to use (0 is the first)

keys.name: MESHTASTIC_HOST
keys.hint: Host of a Meshtastic node's TCP API (licensed nodes only)

keys.name: MESHTASTIC_PORT
keys.hint: TCP port of the Meshtastic node API

keys.name: MESHTASTIC_MQTT_URL
keys.hint: Meshtastic MQTT broker URL (mqtt:// or mqtts://, credentials in the URL)

keys.name: MESHTASTIC_MQTT_TOPIC
keys.hint: MQTT topic of the Meshtastic protobuf feed

keys.name: MESHCOM_NODE
keys.hint: MeshCom node addresses, each optionally =CALL; set it to enable the listener

keys.name: MESHCOM_PORT
keys.hint: UDP port of the MeshCom ExtUDP interface

keys.name: MESHCOM_BIND
keys.hint: Local address the MeshCom listener binds (default: this host on the node's subnet)

keys.name: MESHCOM_FANOUT
keys.hint: host:port targets that receive a copy of each MeshCom datagram

keys.name: MESHCOM_RATE
keys.hint: Most MeshCom datagrams accepted per second from each node

keys.name: MESHCOM_STALE_MIN
keys.hint: Minutes without a MeshCom datagram before the box warns

keys.name: MESHCOM_TX
keys.hint: 1 lets the box answer radio commands through its MeshCom nodes

keys.name: MESHCOM_TX_CALL
keys.hint: Operator call for MeshCom transmit; must match the node's call

keys.name: MESHCOM_TX_AUDIT
keys.hint: Path of a JSON-lines audit file for MeshCom transmits

keys.name: MESHCOM_TX_BURST
keys.hint: MeshCom transmits allowed at once before pacing applies

keys.name: MESHCOM_TX_REFILL_SEC
keys.hint: Seconds to regain one MeshCom transmit

keys.name: MESHCOM_KISS_PASS
keys.hint: The node's KISS password: answers then go out from the service call through KISS

keys.name: MESHCOM_KISS_PORT
keys.hint: The node's KISS TCP port

keys.name: AXUDP_PORT
keys.hint: UDP port for AX.25-over-UDP; set it to enable AXUDP

keys.name: AXUDP_BIND
keys.hint: Local address the AXUDP socket binds

keys.name: AXUDP_PEERS
keys.hint: AXUDP peers as host:port, comma-separated

keys.name: AXIP_ENABLE
keys.hint: Set to enable the AXIP listener (IP protocol 93, needs raw-socket rights)

keys.name: AXIP_PEERS
keys.hint: AXIP peer hosts, comma-separated; set it to enable AXIP

keys.name: AXIP_BIND
keys.hint: Local IPv4 address AXIP takes datagrams on; blank takes every address

keys.name: DIGI_CALL
keys.hint: Callsign of the RF digipeater; set it to enable digipeating

keys.name: DIGI_ALIASES
keys.hint: Aliases the digipeater answers to, comma-separated

keys.name: DIGI_CONNECTED
keys.hint: 1 also digipeats connected-mode AX.25 frames

keys.name: DIGI_VISCOUS_MS
keys.hint: Milliseconds (0-10000) the connected-mode digipeater waits, so a better-placed digi repeats first

keys.name: NETROM_CALL
keys.hint: Callsign of the NET/ROM node; set with NETROM_ALIAS to enable it

keys.name: NETROM_ALIAS
keys.hint: Alias of the NET/ROM node

keys.name: NETROM_BROADCAST_MS
keys.hint: Interval in milliseconds between NODES broadcasts; at least 300000 (5 minutes)

keys.name: NETROM_PATH_QUALITY
keys.hint: Link quality (0-255) assumed for a directly heard neighbour

keys.name: NETROM_INP3
keys.hint: 1 also speaks INP3 alongside NODES

keys.name: NODE_PERSONALITY
keys.hint: Command surface of the node: netrom, flexnet, tnn or baycom

keys.name: BBS_NODE_CALL
keys.hint: Callsign the BBS answers inbound connects on

keys.name: BBS_FORWARD
keys.hint: 1 enables FBB forwarding to partner BBSes

keys.name: BBS_FORWARD_CALL
keys.hint: Callsign the box forwards FBB mail as; default BBS_NODE_CALL

keys.name: BBS_FORWARD_POLL_MS
keys.hint: Interval in milliseconds between forwarding queue checks

keys.name: BBS_FORWARD_SID
keys.hint: SID the box presents to forwarding partners

keys.name: BBS_FORWARD_COMPRESS
keys.hint: 1 offers LZHUF-B1 compressed forwarding

keys.name: BBS_FORWARD_BURST
keys.hint: Forwarding sessions allowed at once before pacing applies

keys.name: BBS_FORWARD_REFILL_SEC
keys.hint: Seconds to regain one forwarding session

keys.name: IGATE_CALL
keys.hint: Callsign of the IGate; set with IGATE_PASS to enable it

keys.name: IGATE_PASS
keys.hint: APRS-IS passcode of the IGate callsign

keys.name: IGATE_FILTER
keys.hint: APRS-IS filter for traffic the IGate may gate to RF

keys.name: IGATE_LOCAL_TTL
keys.hint: Seconds (60-86400) a station counts as heard locally on RF

keys.name: IGATE_TX
keys.hint: 1 lets the IGate pass APRS-IS messages to RF; without it the IGate only receives

keys.name: IGATE_TX_PATH
keys.hint: Digipeater path for frames the IGate transmits; blank sends direct

keys.name: IGATE_TX_BURST
keys.hint: IGate transmits allowed at once before pacing applies

keys.name: IGATE_TX_REFILL_SEC
keys.hint: Seconds to regain one IGate transmit

keys.name: RF_SITE_CALL
keys.hint: Callsign naming this box as the receiving site of what its TNCs hear

keys.name: BOX_ID
keys.hint: Remote-control ID of this box; set it to link the box to your account

keys.name: BOX_KEY
keys.hint: This box's private signing key, written by enrollment; it replaces INGEST_SECRET

keys.name: BOX_TX
keys.hint: 1 allows transmitting on remote command

keys.name: BOX_CALL
keys.hint: Callsign the box transmits remote commands as

keys.name: BOX_TX_PATH
keys.hint: Digipeater path for remote transmits; blank sends direct

keys.name: BOX_CMD_MAX_AGE
keys.hint: Seconds after which a queued remote command is too old to run

keys.name: BOX_POLL_MS
keys.hint: Interval in milliseconds between remote-command polls

keys.name: BOX_TX_BURST
keys.hint: Remote transmits allowed at once before pacing applies

keys.name: BOX_TX_REFILL_SEC
keys.hint: Seconds to regain one remote transmit

keys.name: APRSIS_SERVICE_CALL
keys.hint: APRS-IS uplink login; default the gateway's service call when the feed shares its base

keys.name: APRSIS_SERVICE_PASS
keys.hint: APRS-IS passcode of that login; default APRSIS_PASSCODE

keys.name: CWOP_HOST
keys.hint: CWOP server for relaying weather reports; set it to enable the relay

keys.name: CWOP_PORT
keys.hint: TCP port of the CWOP server

keys.name: PORT
keys.hint: Plain HTTP port the gateway listens on

keys.name: DB_PATH
keys.hint: SQLite database file

keys.name: MIGRATIONS_DIR
keys.hint: Directory of schema migrations applied at boot

keys.name: OFFLINE_TILES_URL
keys.hint: Where phones fetch the offline map archive, when it is hosted elsewhere

keys.name: OFFLINE_TILES_ATTRIBUTION
keys.hint: Attribution of the offline map's data

keys.name: OFFLINE_TILES_MAXZOOM
keys.hint: The most detailed zoom level a pack takes from the offline map

keys.name: OFFLINE_TILES_PATH
keys.hint: The offline map archive (a PMTiles file) this server serves

keys.name: MEDIA_DIR
keys.hint: Directory for uploaded cache media

keys.name: MEDIA_QUOTA_MB
keys.hint: Megabytes of cache media the instance stores in all; uploads stop there

keys.name: FED_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS
keys.hint: Federation peer-sync interval in milliseconds; 0 turns it off

keys.name: WEB_DIST
keys.hint: Built web app directory, served on the same origin as the API

keys.name: HTTPS_PORT
keys.hint: Port of the optional https listener; needs TLS_CERT and TLS_KEY

keys.name: TLS_CERT
keys.hint: PEM certificate, with its chain, for the https listener

keys.name: TLS_KEY
keys.hint: PEM private key for the https listener

keys.name: TLS_CA_CERT
keys.hint: CA certificate offered for download at /pocket-ca.crt

keys.name: LICENCE_SOURCES
keys.hint: Licence registers to import, comma-separated (fcc, ised, acma, at, de or all)

keys.name: BASE
keys.hint: Gateway the licence importer sends to

keys.name: HOST
keys.hint: Address the desktop app listens on; 0.0.0.0 serves the local network

keys.name: DATA_DIR
keys.hint: Where the desktop app keeps its database and media

keys.name: VITE_API_BASE
keys.hint: Gateway base URL, when the API lives on another host than the web app

keys.name: VITE_APP_URL
keys.hint: Public URL of the web app, for its canonical link and Open Graph tags

keys.name: VITE_BASEMAP
keys.hint: offline uses the self-contained grid; anything else the online basemap

keys.name: VITE_BASEMAP_STYLE
keys.hint: MapLibre style URL for the vector basemap

keys.name: VITE_SAT_TILES
keys.hint: Satellite raster tile URL template

keys.name: VITE_SAT_ATTRIBUTION
keys.hint: Attribution shown with the satellite layer

keys.name: VITE_TOOL_REGISTRY
keys.hint: URL of the signed tool registry

keys.name: VITE_TOOL_REGISTRY_AUTHORITY
keys.hint: Ed25519 key the tool registry is verified against

keys.name: DOMAIN
keys.hint: What Caddy serves: a hostname gets Let's Encrypt TLS, :80 serves plain HTTP

keys.name: TUNNEL_TOKEN
keys.hint: Cloudflare Tunnel token of a named tunnel

keys.name: BACKUP_DIR
keys.hint: Local or mounted directory for database backups, off the database's disk

keys.name: OCI_BUCKET
keys.hint: OCI Object Storage bucket for backups (needs the oci CLI)

keys.name: BACKUP_BUCKET
keys.hint: S3-compatible bucket for backups; needs R2_ENDPOINT and the aws CLI

keys.name: R2_ENDPOINT
keys.hint: Endpoint URL of the S3-compatible backup bucket

keys.name: BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS
keys.hint: Days a backup snapshot is kept

keys.name: BACKUP_PRUNE_BUCKET
keys.hint: 1 deletes expired bucket snapshots too, for buckets with no lifecycle rule

keys.name: BACKUP_KEEP
keys.hint: Backup archives kept in their local destination; older ones are deleted

keys.name: CF_API_TOKEN
keys.hint: Cloudflare API token for the CDN cache rules

keys.name: CF_ZONE_ID
keys.hint: Cloudflare zone the CDN cache rules apply to

keys.name: POCKET_ALERTS
keys.hint: 1 vibrates on a new direct message to your call

keys.name: POCKET_ALERTS_SPEAK
keys.hint: 1 also says who a direct message is from

keys.name: POCKET_ALERTS_SPEAK_BODY
keys.hint: 1 reads direct messages aloud too; they may be private

keys.name: POCKET_BATTERY_LOW
keys.hint: Battery percentage below which the saver profile starts; 0 turns it off

keys.name: POCKET_SYNC_MOBILE
keys.hint: 1 lets the manual sync use mobile data, not only Wi-Fi
